academic_requirements.minimum_gpa: 3.0 GPA required; falling below triggers academic warning.
academic_requirements.continuous_enrollment: Must register for coursework each semester OR enroll in GS 700 (thesis/project completion) OR obtain Educational Leave approval.
academic_requirements.grade_forgiveness: NOT permitted for advanced degree students.

milestones.details: Use Degree Planner in MyCSULB to map your academic path. Register via MyCSULB Student Center.
Departmental and college approval of your planned course of study. Required before culminating activity.

details.masters: Thesis, project, and/or comprehensive exam (varies by program)
details.support: Thesis and Dissertation Office provides formatting guidelines and pre-submission consultations

milestones.details: Submit graduation application through MyCSULB Student Records. Degree clearing takes 4–8 weeks post-semester.

submission_deadlines.important_note: Departmental deadlines may be earlier than these university-level cutoffs. Verify with your department.

awards.process: Nominations come from Graduate Advisors and Program Directors only (not self-nominated). Awards distributed each spring.

award_types.name: Graduate Dean's List of University Scholars and Artists
award_types.criteria: Top 1% of enrollment; minimum 3.75 GPA; campus involvement, scholarly activities, or professional leadership

award_types.name: Graduate Student Honors
award_types.criteria: Up to 3 students or 5% of department graduates; overall achievement and program contributions

award_types.name: Distinguished Thesis, Dissertation, and Project Awards
award_types.criteria: Clarity, rigor, originality, creativity, significance, and impact
award_types.process: College nominates one candidate per category by March 15 via Canvas. Requires 250–300 word abstract, complete work, and advisor letter.
